mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of FEDFUNDS decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the unemployment rate threshold (3.5%) signals labor market strength, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positively correlated with UNRATE crossings above 3.5% (Pearson r < 0.1) over any 6-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rates and elevated demand growth (GDPC1) creates a favorable macro environment, enhancing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positively correlated with the joint FEDFUNDS decline and GDPC1 rise (Pearson r < 0.1) over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a contraction in supply (INDPRO) signals peak demand or overproduction, prompting investors to sell equities and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, 60-day forward returns are not positively correlated with INDPRO declines (Pearson r < 0.1) over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Rising supply growth (INDPRO) indicates robust production capacity, reducing inflationary pressures and fostering investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positively correlated with INDPRO increases (Pearson r < 0.1) over any 3-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation crossing above 5% signals policy tightening or market expectations of higher rates, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negatively correlated with CPIAUCSL crossings above 5% (Pearson r > -0.1) over any 6-month period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a robust labor market, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positively correlated with the joint rise in PAYEMS and fall in UNRATE (Pearson r < 0.1) over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, simultaneous low federal funds rates and elevated demand (HOUST) signal economic revitalization, enhancing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-shock recovery regimes, 60-day forward returns are not positively correlated with the joint FEDFUNDS decline and HOUST rise (Pearson r < 0.1) over any 18-month period.
